What you say non-christian, do you mean things that are inherently anti-christian or just stuff thats off topic? The only reason I ask is cause someone may post something that isn't necessarily christian, but relates to a moral shared by many christians. Just curious!

I'm thinking more along the lines of not being connected at all. Talking about a moral would be connected. The conversation would probably also steer that way. The anti-Christian stuff would be covered in the second point.

I would consider Anti-Christian things (as long as it isn't gratuitous and exists only to incite anger) as perfectly related to Christianity. Non-Christian posts would be things like "the weather looks nice today". Anti-Christian material actually is pretty on topic to Christianity.

I feel strongly that we should be accepting and loving of everyone just like Christ was. By that I mean that I hope /v/christfollowers will be a subverse that ooses grace. Are you a sinner? We all are, come on in. Are you a homosexual? Again we all fall short of God's glory, you're welcome just like everyone else. Are you thief? cheater? murderer? Well, it sound like you need a home and a community of people who understand that you are a child of God, no matter what.

As for posts, any blatantly attacking Christians/Christianity or any other group of people, religion, ideology, whatever, should be removed. Aside from that, spam posts should be removed.

I agree. I don't want to start removing posts, etc. Heck, I will be happy to step down as a mod at some point. My purpose in creating this isn't to be a jerk deleting stuff, it's to create a place where Christians and seekers on Voat can have a shared community.

It would also be cool if we could all just be really civil and loving. Let's face we're not all going to agree. There are so many different denominations and ideologies in Christianity. So let's accept that we're all going to believe different things, some of us wildly different. One of the biggest things that has me disenchanted with mainstream Christianity is that you get a lot of denominations who think that they are the only Christians in existence and only they are going to heaven. Let's avoid that, if at all possible. Christians should love each other and accept each other. That means Christians who believe homosexuality is okay, Christians who believe that drug use is alright, and the non-Presbyterian Christians, Catholics, etc.

When I see Christianity, I want to think of love and acceptance, not hate and intolerance. I know that's what Christians are supposed to be, but so often we aren't. I think that, in the spirit of Voat's openness and freedom of speech and diversity, that our mantra should be one of open tolerance, even if we diametrically oppose each other in view.

Just a thought.
